# PDZ3 Analysis (PSD-95)

## Data Loading for PDZ3

Load MoCHI-derived folding (ddGf) and binding (ddGb) free-energy predictions for 1,567 single-amino-acid variants of PSD-95-PDZ3, merge them on a shared variant identifier, and annotate each variant with a manually curated list of orthosteric (ligand-contacting) positions.

```{r}
pdz3_final_df_ddg <- read_csv('/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/cleaned_ddg/pdz3_ddg_cleaned_mochi_refit.csv')

nrow(pdz3_final_df_ddg)
pdz3_final_df_ddgf <- pdz3_final_df_ddg %>% filter(trait_name == "Folding") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(f_ddg_pred = ddg,
                f_ddg_pred_sd = std_ddg)
nrow(pdz3_final_df_ddgf)
pdz3_final_df_ddgb <- pdz3_final_df_ddg %>% filter(trait_name == "Binding") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(b_ddg_pred = ddg,
                b_ddg_pred_sd = std_ddg) %>%
  dplyr::select(id_eve, b_ddg_pred, b_ddg_pred_sd)
nrow(pdz3_final_df_ddgb)

pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot <- merge(pdz3_final_df_ddgf, pdz3_final_df_ddgb, by = "id_eve")

ortho_list <- c(376, 325, 324, 372, 327, 323, 322, 326, 328, 331, 339, 379, 380) #by chimeraX

pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$orthosteric <- FALSE
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$orthosteric[pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$Pos_ref %in% ortho_list] <- TRUE
```

## LOESS Residual Model for PDZ3

Fit a robust LOESS curve (span = 0.7) to ESM-1v scores as a function of measured ddGf, using only non-orthosteric variants as the training set; residuals are then computed for all variants including orthosteric ones.

```{r}
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_out <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>% filter(orthosteric == FALSE)

# Fit a loess model using the filtered data
loess_fit <- loess(ESM1v ~ f_ddg_pred, data = pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_out, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")

# Predict fitted values for ALL data points using the loess model 
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$fitted <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot)

# Calculate residuals for ALL points
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$residuals <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$ESM1v - pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$fitted
```

## PDB B-factor Mapping for PDZ3

Compute per-residue median LOESS residuals and write them into the B-factor column of the 1be9 PDB file so that residual magnitude can be visualised on the structure using ChimeraX.

```{r}
median_residuals <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Pos_ref) %>%
  summarise(median_residuals = median(residuals, na.rm = TRUE))

map_residuals_to_pdb(
  data = median_residuals,
  pdb_path = "/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/residual_pdb/domains/1be9.pdb",
  output_path = "/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/residual_pdb/domains/1be9_median_residual_loess.pdb",
  position_col = "Pos_ref",
  value_col = "median_residuals"
)
```

## Scatter Plot for PDZ3

Plot ESM-1v pathogenicity score against measured ddGf for all 1,567 PDZ3 variants, coloured by LOESS residual, with the fitted LOESS curve overlaid; marginal density plots are added to show the univariate distributions.

```{r, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=4}
fit_line_df <- data.frame(
  f_ddg_pred = seq(min(0, na.rm = TRUE),
                            max(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_out$f_ddg_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
                            length.out = 200)
)

fit_line_df$ESM1v <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = fit_line_df)

cor.test(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$f_ddg_pred, pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$ESM1v, method = "spearman") #-0.4588265 
nrow(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot)

p1 <- ggplot(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot, aes(x = f_ddg_pred, y = ESM1v, color = residuals)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_line(data = fit_line_df, aes(x = f_ddg_pred, y = ESM1v),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PSD-95-PDZ3: All 1,567 Mutations",
    x = "Measured ddGf",
    y = "ESM1v pathogenicity",
    color = "ESM-1v-ddGf Residuals"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(-20.4, 6.2) + xlim(-1.8, 3.7) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "grey", high = "blue", midpoint = 0, name = "Residuals",
                        limits = c(-11.3, 15)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p1 <- add_marginal_density(p1)
p1
```




## Site Classification for PDZ3

Label each non-orthosteric variant as "allosteric" if its predicted ddGb exceeds the mean ddGb of orthosteric variants, creating three site classes (orthosteric, allosteric, other) used in downstream comparisons.

```{r}
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_active <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>% filter (orthosteric == TRUE)
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$allosteric <- FALSE
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$allosteric[pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$b_ddg_pred >= mean(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_active$b_ddg_pred)] <- TRUE
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$allosteric[pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$orthosteric == TRUE] <- FALSE
table(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$allosteric)
```

## Violin Plots for PDZ3

Compare the distribution of ESM-1v–ddGf residuals across orthosteric, allosteric, and other site classes using violin plots with median markers and pairwise Wilcoxon significance brackets.

```{r}
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>%
  mutate(site_class = case_when(
    orthosteric == TRUE ~ "orthosteric",
    allosteric == TRUE ~ "allosteric",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  ))

label_df <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>%
  group_by(site_class) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_val = median(residuals, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$site_class <- factor(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$site_class, levels = c("orthosteric", "allosteric", "other"))

format_p_e_notation <- function(p) {
  if (p < 2.22e-16) return("italic(P) < 2.22e-16")
  
  # Format in scientific notation (e.g., 3.40e-03)
  p_formatted <- formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)
  return(paste0("italic(P) == ", p_formatted))
}

p1 <- wilcox.test(residuals ~ factor(site_class, levels = c("orthosteric", "allosteric")), 
                      data = subset(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot, site_class %in% c("orthosteric", "allosteric")),
                      alternative = "less")$p.value

p2 <- wilcox.test(residuals ~ factor(site_class, levels = c("orthosteric", "other")), 
                      data = subset(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot, site_class %in% c("orthosteric", "other")),
                      alternative = "less")$p.value

p3 <- wilcox.test(residuals ~ factor(site_class, levels = c("allosteric", "other")), 
                      data = subset(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot, site_class %in% c("allosteric", "other")),
                      alternative = "less")$p.value


my_annotations <- c(format_p_e_notation(p1), format_p_e_notation(p2), format_p_e_notation(p3))

p_violin <- ggplot(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot, aes(x = site_class, y = residuals, fill = site_class)) +
   geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.8, color = NA)+
   geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, color = "slategrey", fill = "white", alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
   stat_summary(
     fun.data = median_hilow, 
     fun.args = list(conf.int = 0.95),
     geom = "linerange", 
     color = "slategrey",
     linewidth = 0.5  ) +
     geom_text(
     data = label_df,
     aes(x = site_class, y = max(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot$residuals) * 1.1,
         label = paste0("n = ", n)),
     inherit.aes = FALSE,
     size = 4
   ) +
   geom_text(
     data = label_df,
     aes(x = site_class, y = 10,
         label = paste0("n = ", n)),
     inherit.aes = FALSE,
     size = 4
   ) +
     geom_text(
   data = label_df,
   aes(x = site_class, y = median_val + 1.9, label = sprintf("%.2f", median_val)),
   inherit.aes = FALSE,
   size = 6
 ) +   geom_signif(
     comparisons = list(
       c("orthosteric", "allosteric"),
       c("orthosteric", "other"),
       c("allosteric", "other")
     ),
     annotations = my_annotations, # Provide pre-formatted labels
     parse = TRUE,                 # Mandates R to render plotmath (italics/notation)
     step_increase = 0.1,
     tip_length = 0.01,
     textsize = 3.5
   ) +
   # Labels and theme
   labs(
     title = "PSD-95-PDZ3",
     subtitle = "",
     x = "",
     y = "ESM-1v-ddGf residual"
   ) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = c(
     "orthosteric" = "#E69F00",
     "allosteric" = "#4DBBD5",
     "other" = "#999999"
   )) +
   theme_classic() +
   theme(legend.position = "none")

p_violin
```

## Exponential Decay of Residuals vs. Ligand Distance for PDZ3

Fit a two-parameter exponential decay model (`|residual| ~ a * exp(-b * distance)`) to variants with negative residuals to quantify how the ESM-1v surplus signal falls off with increasing distance from the CRIPT peptide ligand; bootstrap resampling (n = 1,000) provides 95% confidence intervals on the decay curve.

```{r}
pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>% filter (residuals <= 0)

exp_model_pdz3 <- nls(abs(residuals) ~ a * exp(-b * scHAmin_ligand),
                 data = pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg,
                 start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1))
exp_model_pdz3
```
### Log-linear Validation of Decay (PDZ3)

Confirm the exponential relationship by fitting a log-linear model to per-residue median residuals versus ligand distance; the slope and adjusted R-squared are reported as a complementary diagnostic.

```{r}
merged_df_residue <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg  %>%
  group_by(Pos_ref) %>%
  summarise(
    loess_residual_avg = median(residuals, na.rm = TRUE),
    scHAmin_ligand = dplyr::first(scHAmin_ligand))

lm_model <- lm(log(abs(loess_residual_avg)) ~ scHAmin_ligand, data = merged_df_residue)
summary(lm_model)
# Call:
# lm(formula = log(abs(loess_residual_avg)) ~ scHAmin_ligand, data = merged_df_residue)
# 
# Residuals:
#     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
# -3.9474 -0.4673  0.2511  0.5713  1.4091 
# 
# Coefficients:
#                Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)     1.71692    0.26025   6.597 4.35e-09 ***
# scHAmin_ligand -0.13428    0.02485  -5.403 6.74e-07 ***
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 
# Residual standard error: 0.9309 on 79 degrees of freedom
# Multiple R-squared:  0.2698,	Adjusted R-squared:  0.2605 
# F-statistic: 29.19 on 1 and 79 DF,  p-value: 6.743e-07
```


## Decay Plot for PDZ3 Residuals

Visualise the absolute LOESS residuals against side-chain heavy-atom distance to ligand for negative-residual variants, overlaying the bootstrapped exponential decay curve with its 95% CI ribbon; points are coloured by site class.

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
a <- coef(exp_model_pdz3)[["a"]]
b <- coef(exp_model_pdz3)[["b"]]

pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg %>%
  mutate(expected_ddgb = a * exp(-b * scHAmin_ligand),
         residual = abs(residuals) - expected_ddgb)

half_d <- log(2) / b  # 7.155389
half_d

table(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg$site_class)

x_vals <- seq(min(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg$scHAmin_ligand, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg$scHAmin_ligand, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 200)

# --- Bootstrapping for confidence intervals ---
set.seed(11)
boot_params <- replicate(1000, {
  samp <- pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg[sample(nrow(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg), replace = TRUE), ]
  fit <- try(nlsLM(abs(residuals) ~ a * exp(-b * scHAmin_ligand),
                   data = samp, start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1)), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) c(NA, NA) else coef(fit)
})
boot_params <- t(boot_params)[complete.cases(t(boot_params)), ]

boot_preds <- apply(boot_params, 1, function(p) p[1] * exp(-p[2] * x_vals))

fit_df_residue <- data.frame(
  scHAmin_ligand = x_vals,
  median_ddgb = predict(exp_model_pdz3, newdata = data.frame(scHAmin_ligand = x_vals)),
  lower = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  upper = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
)

p_decay <- ggplot(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg, aes(x = scHAmin_ligand, y = abs(residuals))) +
  geom_point(data = subset(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg, site_class == "other"),
             aes(color = site_class), 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = subset(pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg, site_class != "other"),
             aes(color = site_class), 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = fit_df_residue,
              aes(x = scHAmin_ligand, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = fit_df_residue, aes(x = scHAmin_ligand, y = abs(median_ddgb)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 1) +

  # --- Styling ---
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "other" = "#999999",
    "orthosteric" = "#E69F00",
    "allosteric" = "#4DBBD5"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "PSD-95-PDZ3",
    x = "Minimal distance to ligand",
    y = "|ESM-1v-ddGf residual|",
    color = ""
  ) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_decay <- add_marginal_density(p_decay)

p_decay
```
```{r}
ggsave("/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/figs/revision/fig4_decay1.pdf", 
       plot = p_decay, width = 3, height = 3, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
                 data = pdz3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos,

exp_model_pdz3_ddgb
```

```{r}
process_and_merge_protein_data <- function(protein_data, merged_df) {

  # Merge with popEVE and ESM1v data
  merged_df_ddg <- merged_df %>%
    merge(protein_data$popeve, by.x = "id_ref", by.y = "id",all.x = FALSE) %>%
    merge(protein_data$esm1v, by.x = "id_ref", by.y = "id", all.x = FALSE)

  return(merged_df_ddg)
}

  dplyr::rename(old_id = id_ref) %>%

  dplyr::rename(f_ddg_pred = `mean_kcal/mol`) %>%
```

## LOESS Residual Model for SH3

Annotate SH3 variants with orthosteric positions (defined by ChimeraX contact analysis of 2vwf.pdb), then fit a non-orthosteric LOESS model and compute residuals for all variants using the same procedure as PDZ3.

```{r}
ortho_list <- c(190, 171, 174, 165, 167, 208, 206, 193, 170, 192, 195, 204 ,209)
sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot$orthosteric <- FALSE
sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot$orthosteric[sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot$Pos_ref %in% ortho_list] <- TRUE

sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_out <- sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>% filter(orthosteric == FALSE)

# Fit a loess model using the filtered data
loess_fit <- loess(ESM1v ~ f_ddg_pred, data = sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_out, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")

# Predict fitted values for ALL data points using the loess model 
sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot$fitted <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot)

# Calculate residuals for ALL points
sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot$residuals <- sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot$ESM1v - sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot$fitted
```

## Ligand Distance Calculation for SH3

Define a helper function that reads the 2vwf crystal structure and computes per-residue minimum inter-chain heavy-atom (and side-chain heavy-atom) distances between chain A (SH3) and chain B (SOS1 peptide), then merge those distances into the variant-level data frame.

```{r}
doubledeepms__minimum_interchain_distances_from_PDB_perres <- function(
	input_file,
  chain_query = "A",
  chain_target = "B"
  ){
  
  #load PDB structure
#	sink(file = "/dev/null")
  pdb <- bio3d::read.pdb(input_file, rm.alt = TRUE)
#	sink()

  ### Atom selections
  ###########################

	#Protein atoms
  sele_protein <- bio3d::atom.select(pdb, "protein", verbose=FALSE)
	#Hydrogen atoms
  sele_H <-bio3d::atom.select(pdb, "h", verbose=FALSE)
	#Water atoms
  sele_water <- bio3d::atom.select(pdb, "water", verbose=FALSE)
	#Side chain atoms
  sele_sc <- bio3d::atom.select(pdb, "sidechain", verbose=FALSE)
	#C-alpha atoms
  sele_ca <- bio3d::atom.select(pdb, "calpha", verbose=FALSE)
	#Glycine c-alpha atoms
  sele_glyca <- bio3d::atom.select(pdb, resid = "GLY", string = "calpha", verbose=FALSE)

  ### Combine atom selections
  ###########################

  #Heavy atoms
	sele_HA <- bio3d::combine.select(sele_protein, sele_H, sele_water, operator = "-", verbose=FALSE)

  #Side chain heavy atoms + c-alpha for glycine
	sele_prot_sc <- bio3d::combine.select(sele_protein, sele_sc, operator = "AND", verbose=FALSE)
	sele_prot_sc_glyca <- bio3d::combine.select(sele_prot_sc, sele_glyca, operator = "OR", verbose=FALSE)
	sele_scHA <- bio3d::combine.select(sele_prot_sc_glyca, sele_H, sele_water, operator = "-", verbose=FALSE)

	#List
	sele_list <- list(
		"HA" = sele_HA,
		"scHA" = sele_scHA)

  ### Calculate minimum target chain distances
  ###########################

 	result_dt <- data.table()
  for(metric in names(sele_list)){
	  #Distance matrix
		pdb_sub <- bio3d::trim.pdb(pdb, sele_list[[metric]])
	  dist_mat <- bio3d::dm.xyz(pdb_sub$xyz, grpby=apply(pdb_sub$atom[,c("resno", "chain")], 1, paste, collapse = "_"), scut=0, mask.lower = FALSE)
	  resno_sub <- unique(pdb_sub$atom[,c("resno", "chain")])
	  #Ligand distance matrix
	  ligand_dist <- dist_mat[resno_sub[,"chain"]==chain_query,resno_sub[,"chain"]==chain_target]
	  ligand_dist_df <- ligand_dist
	  colnames(ligand_dist_df) <- resno_sub[resno_sub[,"chain"]==chain_target,"resno"]
	  rownames(ligand_dist_df) <- resno_sub[resno_sub[,"chain"]==chain_query,"resno"]
	  #chain target names
	  #Absolute residue number
	  ligand_dist_dt <- data.table(Pos = resno_sub[resno_sub[,"chain"]==chain_query,"resno"])
	  #Minimum ligand distance
	  ligand_dist_dt[, min_dist := apply(ligand_dist, 1, min)]
	  names(ligand_dist_dt)[2] <- paste0(metric, "min_ligand")
	  if(nrow(result_dt)==0){
	  	result_dt <- ligand_dist_dt
	  }else{
	  	result_dt <- merge(result_dt, ligand_dist_dt, by = "Pos", all = T)
	  }
	 result_dt_with_ligand_matrix <- cbind(result_dt, ligand_dist_df)
  }

  #Return
	return(result_dt_with_ligand_matrix)

}

sh3_out <- doubledeepms__minimum_interchain_distances_from_PDB_perres(
  input_file = "/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/residual_pdb/domains/2vwf.pdb",
  chain_query = "A",
  chain_target = "B"
```

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
  median_ddgb = predict(exp_model_sh3, newdata = data.frame(scHAmin_ligand = x_vals)),
  lower = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  upper = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
)

p_decay2 <- ggplot(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg, aes(x = scHAmin_ligand, y = abs(residuals))) +
  geom_point(data = subset(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg, site_class == "other"),
             aes(color = site_class), 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = subset(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_neg, site_class != "other"),
             aes(color = site_class),

            inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 1) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
```

```{r}
sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos <- sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>% filter (b_ddg_pred >= 0)

exp_model_sh3_ddgb <- nls(b_ddg_pred ~ a * exp(-b * scHAmin_ligand),
                 data = sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos,
                 start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1))
exp_model_sh3_ddgb
```


```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
a <- coef(exp_model_sh3_ddgb)[["a"]]
b <- coef(exp_model_sh3_ddgb)[["b"]]

sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos <- sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos %>%
  mutate(expected_ddgb = a * exp(-b * scHAmin_ligand),
         residual = b_ddg_pred - expected_ddgb)

half_d <- log(2) / b  # 5.873301
half_d

x_vals <- seq(min(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos$scHAmin_ligand, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos$scHAmin_ligand, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 200)

# --- Bootstrapping for confidence intervals ---
set.seed(11)
boot_params <- replicate(1000, {
  samp <- sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos[sample(nrow(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos), replace = TRUE), ]
  fit <- try(nlsLM(b_ddg_pred ~ a * exp(-b * scHAmin_ligand),
                   data = samp, start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1)), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) c(NA, NA) else coef(fit)
})
boot_params <- t(boot_params)[complete.cases(t(boot_params)), ]

boot_preds <- apply(boot_params, 1, function(p) p[1] * exp(-p[2] * x_vals))

fit_df_residue <- data.frame(
  scHAmin_ligand = x_vals,
  median_ddgb = predict(exp_model_sh3_ddgb, newdata = data.frame(scHAmin_ligand = x_vals)),
  lower = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  upper = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
)

p_decay <- ggplot(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos, aes(x = scHAmin_ligand, y = b_ddg_pred)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos, site_class == "other"),
             aes(color = site_class), 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = subset(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos, site_class == "allosteric"),
             aes(color = site_class), 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = subset(sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot_pos, site_class == "orthosteric"),
             aes(color = site_class), 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = fit_df_residue,
              aes(x = scHAmin_ligand, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = fit_df_residue, aes(x = scHAmin_ligand, y = median_ddgb),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 1) +

  # --- Styling ---
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "other" = "#999999",
    "allosteric" = "#4DBBD5",
    "orthosteric" = "#E69F00"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "GRB2-SH3",
    x = "Minimal distance to ligand",
    y = "ddGb",
    color = ""
  ) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_decay <- add_marginal_density(p_decay)

p_decay
```

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4.5}
merged_df_residue <- sh3_final_df_ddg_2plot %>%
  group_by(Pos_ref) %>%
  reframe(
    median_ddgb = median(b_ddg_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_residual = median(residuals, na.rm = TRUE),
    scHAmin_ligand = dplyr::first(scHAmin_ligand),
    orthosteric = dplyr::first(orthosteric),
    Pos = dplyr::first(Pos_ref))

nrow(merged_df_residue) #56
cor.test(merged_df_residue$median_residual, merged_df_residue$median_ddgb, method = "spearman")

merged_df_residue$site_type <- "Non-orthosteric site"
merged_df_residue$site_type[merged_df_residue$orthosteric == TRUE] <- "Orthosteric site"
```
